supported_inferences: Qwen3.5-4B is cleaner at raw script generation and slightly faster, but those gains do not compensate for worse semantic preservation and register control under the current contract.
Qwen3.5-9B is not a stronger current RightBrain carrier: it never uniquely succeeds where the control fails, and polite or service-register drift rises from 2/10 to 7/10.
A newer or larger general model is not sufficient to realize the current public-persona surface contract.
Together with the prior V34 guarded-retry confirmation failure, the next justified work is not another base-model swap or retry policy.

next_research_direction.problem: The current structured persona-policy contract asks the carrier to preserve several semantic groups, obey a casual register, respect length, and apply expression policy at once. Existing base swaps and guarded retries do not reliably satisfy this exact role.
next_research_direction.recommended_unit: Audit whether the existing generic RightBrain training curriculum actually covers every field and failure mode of the current structured persona-policy contract. Only if a measurable coverage gap exists should a source-separated, person-independent role-specialization curriculum be built and trained.
next_research_direction.why_this_precedes_training: The project already has RightBrain adapters and a prior guarded-retry negative result. Training again without proving a current-contract curriculum gap would repeat an unsupported direction.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not train on these five development outputs or expected replies.
Do not select Qwen3.5 solely because its raw language pollution is lower.
Do not weaken the semantic or register gate to make a candidate pass.
Do not interpret this as a target-person personality comparison.

evidence_boundary: This valid negative result rejects a direct local carrier swap for the exact current five-case development contract. It does not establish production quality, persona similarity, or the performance of a future role-specialized model on independent data.
